attributes.text: The profile decides how much work the app does for every word you tap. A stronger profile needs more memory and more downloads.
Ready: this profile runs on this device.
Strongest profile this device can run: Basic
What Basic does with each line
Uses the lexicon pack only: phrases and meanings come from the pack. No model, no download.
1. Find phrasal verbs, idioms and collocations in the line, using the pack's patterns. No model.
2. Look up each word in the pack by its base form (lemma). No model.
3. Keep the pack's own order: the primary meaning first, then the part of speech that matches. No model.
Only words with more than one meaning are ranked; a word with one meaning shows that meaning.
Try the packs and profiles on a real subtitle file, without playing a video, and see what each one finds and costs.
